EngineException 不得继承 CancellationException（4.3 强制约束）\n2. 源实现（source/）不得直接引用 UI 层\n3. LocalParseProxy 只允许绑定 127.0.0.1\n4. 关键 TODO 必须带编号（TODO-DEV-*），便于评审追踪\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nMAIN = Path(\"app/src/main/java\")\n\n\ndef read_all(path: Path):\n    return [(f, f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")) for f in path.rglob(\"*.kt\")]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    problems = []\n\n    engine = MAIN / \"com/lanyue/reader/core/engine/Engine.kt\"\n    if engine.exists():\n        text = engine.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        m = re.search(r\"class EngineException\\([^)]*\\)\\s*:\\s*([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\", text, re.S)\n        if m and \"CancellationException\" in m.group(1):\n            problems.append(\"Engine.kt: EngineException 不得继承 CancellationException\")\n    else:\n        problems.append(\"缺少 Engine.kt\")\n\n    for f, text in read_all(MAIN / \"com/lanyue/reader/source\"):\n        if re.search(r\"import com\\.lanyue\\.reader\\.ui\", text):\n            problems.append(f\"{f}: 源层不得依赖 UI 层\")\n\n    proxy = MAIN / \"com/lanyue/reader/source/video/LocalParseProxy.kt\"\n    if proxy.exists():\n        text = proxy.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        if \"0.0.0.0\" in text:\n            problems.append(\"LocalParseProxy.kt: 禁止绑定 0.0.0.0\")\n\n    for f, text in read_all(MAIN):\n        for m in re.finditer(r\"TODO(?!-DEV-)[^ \\n]*\", text):\n            problems.append(f\"{f}: TODO 未带编号 -> {m.group(0)}\")\n\n    if problems:\n        print(\"[FAIL] 架构门禁：\")\n        for p in problems:\n            print(\"  -\", p)\n        return 1\n\n    print(\"[OK] 架构契约门禁通过\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"}, {"path": "tools/check_disclaimer.py", "lang": "py", "lines": 48, "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"合规门禁：免责声明与版权声明必须存在于 strings.xml。\n\n要求（见产品合规章节）：\n1. 免责声明明确\"内容来自第三方源，App 不存储、不分发\"\n2. 明确\"用户自行承担使用风险\"与\"举报/下架通道\"\n\"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom xml.etree import ElementTree as ET\n\nTARGET = Path(\"app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml\")\n\nREQUIRED_KEYS = {\n    \"disclaimer_title\",\n    \"disclaimer_body\",\n    \"disclaimer_copyright\",\n    \"disclaimer_report\",\n}\n\nREQUIRED_PHRASES = [\"第三方\", \"不存储\"]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    if not TARGET.exists():\n        print(f\"[FAIL] strings.xml 不存在: {TARGET}\")\n        return 1\n\n    root = ET.parse(TARGET).getroot()\n    values = {el.get(\"name\"): (el.text or \"\") for el in root if el.tag == \"string\"}\n\n    missing = REQUIRED_KEYS - set(values)\n    if missing:\n        print(\"[FAIL] 缺少免责声明条目：\", sorted(missing))\n        return 1\n\n    body = values[\"disclaimer_body\"] + values[\"disclaimer_copyright\"]\n    for phrase in REQUIRED_PHRASES:\n        if phrase not in body:\n            print(f\"[FAIL] 免责声明缺少关键表述：{phrase}\")\n            return 1\n\n    print(\"[OK] 免责声明门禁通过\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"}, {"path": "tools/check_no_telemetry.py", "lang": "py", "lines": 55, "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"合规门禁：本地埋点不得有网络出口。\n\n第八章要求：埋点只落本地文件（LocalMetrics -> 本地环形日志），\n禁止上报、禁止初始化第三方统计 SDK、禁止向远端发请求。\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nSRC = Path(\"app/src/main/java\")\nMETRICS_DIR = SRC / \"com/lanyue/reader/core/observability\"\n\nNET_HINTS = re.compile(\n    r\"HttpURLConnection|OkHttpClient|openConnection\\(|Retrofit|\"\n    r\"firebase|umeng|appsflyer|sensorsdata|bugly\",\n    re.I,\n)\n\nTHIRD_PARTY_SDK = re.compile(\n    r\"com\\.google\\.firebase|com\\.umeng|com\\.bugly|com\\.appsflyer|\"\n    r\"com\\.sensorsdata|cn\\.jpush|com\\.tencent\\.bugly\",\n)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    problems = []\n\n    if METRICS_DIR.exists():\n        for f in METRICS_DIR.rglob(\"*.kt\"):\n            text = f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n            for m in NET_HINTS.finditer(text):\n                problems.append(f\"{f}: 埋点模块出现网络/SDK 特征 {m.group(0)}\")\n\n    build = Path(\"app/build.gradle.kts\")\n    if build.exists():\n        for line in build.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines():\n            s = line.strip()\n            if s.startswith(\"//\") or not s.startswith(\"implementation(\"):\n                continue\n            if THIRD_PARTY_SDK.search(s):\n                problems.append(f\"build.gradle.kts: 引入第三方统计 SDK -> {s}\")\n\n    if problems:\n        print(\"[FAIL] 存在数据上报风险：\")\n        for p in problems:\n            print(\"  -\", p)\n        return 1\n\n    print(\"[OK] 无遥测出口门禁通过\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"}, {"path": "tools/check_permissions.py", "lang": "py", "lines": 76, "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"第六章 6.2.4 权限最小化门禁。\n\n校验 AndroidManifest.xml 的 uses-permission 只能是白名单集合。\n白名单是\"允许集\"，不代表都是非危险级；POST_NOTIFICATIONS 属 dangerous，\n必须运行时请求（见 ui 层 requestPermission）。\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nALLOWED = {\n    \"android.permission.INTERNET\",\n    \"android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE\",\n    \"android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS\",\n    \"android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE\",\n    \"android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK\",\n    \"android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC\",\n    \"android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE\",\n    \"android.permission.WAKE_LOCK\",\n}\n\nFORBIDDEN_HINTS = (\n    \"READ_PHONE_STATE\",\n    \"READ_SMS\",\n    \"READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE\",\n    \"QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES\",\n    \"MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE\",\n    \"ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION\",\n    \"READ_CONTACTS\",\n    \"RECORD_AUDIO\",\n    \"CAMERA\",\n)\n\nMANIFEST = Path(\"app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    if not MANIFEST.exists():\n        print(f\"[FAIL] manifest not found: {MANIFEST}\")\n        return 1\n\n    text = MANIFEST.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    declared = set(re.findall(r'android:name=\"(android\\.permission\\.[A-Z_]+)\"', text))\n\n    extra = declared - ALLOWED\n    if extra:\n        print(\"[FAIL] 超出权限白名单：\")\n        for p in sorted(extra):\n            print(f\"  - {p}\")\n        return 1\n\n    bad = [p for p in declared if any(h in p for h in FORBIDDEN_HINTS)]\n    if bad:\n        print(\"[FAIL] 命中禁止清单：\", bad)\n        return 1\n\n    # 前台服务类型必须与代码用途一致\n    for svc, need in (\n        (\"MediaDownloadService\", \"dataSync\"),\n        (\"AudioPlaybackService\", \"mediaPlayback\"),\n    ):\n        m = re.search(r'android:name=\"\\.player\\.' + svc + r'\"(.*?)/>', text, re.S)\n        if not m:\n            print(f\"[FAIL] 未声明服务 {svc}\")\n            return 1\n        if need not in m.group(1):\n            print(f\"[FAIL] {svc} foregroundServiceType 应为 {need}\")\n            return 1\n\n    print(f\"[OK] 权限门禁通过，已声明 {len(declared)} 项，均在白名单内\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"}, {"path": "tools/ci.sh", "lang": "sh", "lines": 17, "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# 合规 + 架构门禁总入口。CI 与本地提交前均执行。\nset -euo pipefail\ncd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\"\n\nfail=0\nfor script in tools/check_permissions.py tools/check_disclaimer.py \\\n              tools/check_no_telemetry.py tools/check_contracts.py; do\n    echo \"== $script\"\n    python3 \"$script\" || fail=1\ndone\n\nif [ \"$fail\" -ne 0 ]; then\n    echo \"合规门禁未通过，禁止合并\"\n    exit 1\nfi\necho \"全部门禁通过\"\n"}, {"path": "tools/test_jvm.sh", "lang": "sh", "lines": 87, "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# 脱机 JVM 测试验证脚本：编译纯逻辑层 + 测试，运行全部 main() 测试。\n# 依赖：JDK 17、kotlin-compiler-2.0.20、kotlinx-coroutines-core、jsoup。\nset -euo pipefail\ncd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\"\n\nKC=${KC:-/tmp/opencode/kotlinc/kotlinc/bin/kotlinc}\nCP_DIR=${CP_DIR:-/tmp/opencode}\nJARS=\"$CP_DIR/kotlin-stdlib22.jar:$CP_DIR/coroutines-core.jar:$CP_DIR/jsoup.jar:$CP_DIR/gson.jar:$CP_DIR/okhttp.jar:$CP_DIR/okio.jar:$CP_DIR/conscrypt.jar\"\nOUT=${OUT:-/tmp/opencode/out}\n\nmkdir -p \"$OUT\"\n\n# Android 硬依赖的文件排除（纯 JVM 层之外的），OkHttp/Gson/Log 桩保留\nEXCLUDES=(\n  \"LanyueApp.kt\"\n  \"data/db/CatalogDaos.kt\"\n  \"data/db/Converters.kt\"\n  \"data/db/LanyueDatabase.kt\"\n  \"data/db/SourceDaos.kt\"\n  \"core/security/KeystoreSecretStore.kt\"\n  \"core/engine/RssFallbackParser.kt\"\n  \"danmaku/DanmakuMatchEngine.kt\"\n  \"danmaku/render/DanmakuFormatConverter.kt\"\n  \"danmaku/render/DanmakuCanvasLayer.kt\"\n  \"player/\"\n  \"source/video/LocalParseProxy.kt\"\n  \"source/video/CmsVideoSource.kt\"\n  \"source/book/LegadoBookSource.kt\"\n  \"source/danmaku/DandanplaySource.kt\"\n  \"source/rss/LegadoRssSource.kt\"\n  \"source/SourceRegistry.kt\"\n)\n\nSRCS=()\nwhile IFS= read -r f; do\n  skip=0\n  for ex in \"${EXCLUDES[@]}\"; do\n    if [[ \"$f\" == *\"$ex\"* ]]; then skip=1; break; fi\n  done\n  [ \"$skip\" -eq 0 ] && SRCS+=(\"$f\")\ndone < <(find app/src/main/java -name \"*.kt\" | sort)\n\nTESTS=$(find tests -name \"*.kt\" | sort)\n\n\"$KC\" -jvm-target 17 \\\n  -classpath \"$JARS\" \\\n  -d \"$OUT/tests.jar\" \\\n  \"${SRCS[@]}\" $CP_DIR/stub/android/util/Log.kt $CP_DIR/stub/androidx/room/Entity.kt $CP_DIR/stub/androidx/room/PrimaryKey.kt $CP_DIR/stub/androidx/room/Index.kt $TESTS 2>&1\n\necho \"== 编译通过，运行测试 ==\"\n# pipefail 下 grep -q 提前退出会让 unzip 以 SIGPIPE 失败，先取全量清单再匹配\nJAR_LIST=$(unzip -l \"$OUT/tests.jar\" || true)\nfor cls in \\\n  RuleEngineDispatchTestKt \\\n  JsonXpathTestKt \\\n  SourceLayerTestKt \\\n  ReadingLayerTestKt \\\n  BackupLayerTestKt \\\n  SourceImportLayerTestKt \\\n  ShelfAggregateLayerTestKt \\\n  DanmakuFilterTestKt \\\n  SecurityGuardTestKt \\\n  EngineRuleSyntaxTestKt \\\n  EngineCoreTestKt \\\n  RuleEngineDispatchRound2TestKt \\\n  NetworkDispatcherE2ETestKt \\\n  RuleChainTestKt \\\n  JsRuntimePoolTestKt \\\n  SourceRouterTestKt \\\n  SourceValidatorTestKt \\\n  CapabilityResolverTestKt \\\n  TvBoxParserTestKt \\\n  SortUrlParserTestKt \\\n  TextPurifierTestKt \\\n  PurifyRuleCodecTestKt \\\n  PurifyPipelineTestKt \\\n  TtsReadTestKt \\\n  DanmakuSourceLayerTestKt \\\n  AppShellTestKt; do\n  if grep -q \"$cls\" <<< \"$JAR_LIST\"; then\n    java -cp \"$OUT/tests.jar:$JARS\" \"$cls\" || exit 1\n    echo \"\"\n  else\n    echo \"跳过（jar 中无此类）：$cls\"\n  fi\ndone\n"}]
